title: BrandKit Assets Over 50MB Fail to Sync Silently Without an Error
alternate_search_terms: large assets missing from asset library
assets over 50MB not appearing in stack

extracted_facts.problem: The customer's BrandKit assets over 50MB were failing to sync into the stack's asset library, with no error shown to the user.
extracted_facts.root_cause: The workspace's sync connector had a default upload size cap of 50MB that silently dropped larger files instead of erroring.
resolution_steps: The customer raised the connector's upload size limit in its configuration settings.
